description: This file defines the 'MacNodeModeCoordinator' class responsible for managing the node's lifecycle, connection to the gateway, and configuration of capabilities and permissions within a macOS application. It handles starting and stopping the node, maintaining persistent connection sessions, and updating runtime state based on external configurations and user preferences.

classes.name: MacNodeModeCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the lifecycle and connection logic of the node within the macOS environment, coordinating capabilities, permissions, and communication with a gateway.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the coordinator by creating an asynchronous task to run its main loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the coordinator by canceling the ongoing task and disconnecting the session.

methods.name: setPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Sets the preferred stable ID for the gateway discovery preferences and disconnects the current session.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main asynchronous loop that manages reconnection logic, configuration fetching, and session management.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Determines the current capabilities of the node based on user preferences and configurations.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Generates a list of available commands based on capabilities.

methods.name: buildSessionBox
methods.description: Builds a WebSocket session box with TLS parameters based on the gateway URL.
